scope_note: Derived ONLY from telegram-llm-bot repos ['AstrBot', 'ChatGPT-Telegram-Bot', 'LangBot', 'nekro-agent']. Categories are app-type-relative — this checklist does NOT transfer to other app types.

required.aliases: error message improvement / error handling / async error handling
required.day1_tell: Trigger a known async failure; confirm the user-facing error includes context and the process does not crash.

required.aliases: timeout error handling / timeout adjustment / session timeout handling
required.day1_tell: Run a request that exceeds the configured timeout; confirm it aborts with a clear timeout error and frees the session.

required.aliases: localization updates / localization display fix / language localization support
required.day1_tell: Switch UI language to a non-default locale; confirm labels, dates, and fallback strings render correctly.

required.aliases: empty value handling / empty input validation / null usage handling
required.day1_tell: Submit empty string, whitespace, and null values; confirm validation rejects or handles them without exceptions.

required.aliases: dependency fix / missing dependency fix / dependency removal
required.day1_tell: Install from a clean environment; confirm dependency resolution succeeds with no missing or unused required packages.

required.aliases: provider integration / provider compatibility fix / provider api compatibility
required.day1_tell: Call the integrated provider with a minimal valid request; confirm authentication, request shape, and response parsing work.

required.aliases: environment configuration / default configuration / default configuration update
required.day1_tell: Start with no config file; confirm documented defaults are applied and visible.

required.aliases: api compatibility fix / api format compatibility / api response compatibility
required.day1_tell: Send old and new API response formats; confirm both are parsed or the unsupported one errors clearly.

required.aliases: file message support / message formatting fix / document message support
required.day1_tell: Send a message containing a document/file attachment; confirm it is accepted and formatted correctly.

required.aliases: failure notification fix / message parsing normalization / message sending
required.day1_tell: Force message send failure; confirm a normalized failure notification is emitted once with the parsed reason.

required.aliases: proxy support / proxy dependency support / proxy support bundling
required.day1_tell: Run through an HTTP/SOCKS proxy; confirm outbound requests use the proxy and still succeed.

required.aliases: type usage fix / type correctness fix / type checking fix
required.day1_tell: Run static type checking; confirm the touched module has no type errors or unsafe casts.

required.aliases: message merging fix / message segmentation merge / message segmentation
required.day1_tell: Send segmented messages that should merge; confirm final content preserves order and boundaries.

required.aliases: module import fix / import warning fix / missing import fix
required.day1_tell: Import the package from a clean runtime; confirm no missing import errors or import warnings appear.

required.aliases: empty response handling / null reply handling / null response handling
required.day1_tell: Mock an empty/null provider response; confirm the client handles it gracefully without rendering 'null'.

required.aliases: permission management / command permission hardening / command permission configuration
required.day1_tell: Attempt a restricted command as an unprivileged user; confirm it is denied and logged.

required.aliases: schema conversion fix / schema compatibility fix / schema requirement fix
required.day1_tell: Validate converted schema against the target runtime; confirm required fields and types match.

required.aliases: deployment scripting / deployment script enhancement / deployment script fix
required.day1_tell: Run the deployment script on a clean checkout; confirm it exits zero and produces expected artifacts.

required.aliases: identifier parsing fix / identifier correction / identifier retrieval fix
required.day1_tell: Parse identifiers containing hyphens, underscores, and numbers; confirm the retrieved ID matches exactly.

required.aliases: lazy dependency loading / deferred dependency loading / dynamic dependency loading
required.day1_tell: Start without optional dependency installed; confirm app boots and only loads dependency when feature is used.

required.aliases: pagination size change / pagination parameter fix / responsive pagination
required.day1_tell: Request page size at min, max, and invalid values; confirm pagination behaves responsively and validates input.

required.aliases: adapter integration / adapter configuration / adapter implementation
required.day1_tell: Enable the adapter with sample config; confirm it initializes and routes one request successfully.

required.aliases: status indicator fix / status reporting / status display correction
required.day1_tell: Force each status state; confirm the indicator displays the correct label/color.

required.aliases: plugin invocation fix / plugin installation fix / plugin execution fix
required.day1_tell: Install and invoke a sample plugin; confirm lifecycle hooks run and output is returned.

required.aliases: layout display fix / layout spacing fix / responsive layout fixes
required.day1_tell: Resize viewport across breakpoints; confirm layout spacing does not overlap or clip.

required.aliases: markdown rendering control / markdown rendering support / markdown error rendering
required.day1_tell: Render markdown with code, links, and malformed syntax; confirm expected rendering and safe fallback.

required.aliases: search provider integration / web search integration / search integration
required.day1_tell: Run a web search query through configured provider; confirm results are returned and attributed.

required.aliases: hot reload fix / development hot reload / configuration hot reload
required.day1_tell: Change config during development; confirm hot reload applies once without restart.

required.aliases: url parsing fix / url extraction fix / url parameter parsing
required.day1_tell: Parse URL with encoded params, fragments, and trailing slash; confirm extracted fields are correct.

required.aliases: api configuration / dynamic api configuration / api configuration fix
required.day1_tell: Change API base URL/model in config; confirm subsequent requests use the new values.

required.aliases: command system refactor / command configuration change / command settings refactor
required.day1_tell: Run legacy and new command configuration examples; confirm commands resolve identically or migrate cleanly.

required.aliases: context compression / context compression fallback / context propagation
required.day1_tell: Send context exceeding limit; confirm compression/fallback preserves essential messages and request succeeds.

required.aliases: default model update / default model presets / default model change
required.day1_tell: Create a fresh profile; confirm the documented default model/preset is selected.

required.aliases: empty prompt handling / prompt behavior / prompt management
required.day1_tell: Submit an empty prompt; confirm it is blocked or handled with documented behavior.

required.aliases: plugin lifecycle cleanup / plugin data cleanup / plugin lifecycle management
required.day1_tell: Disable/delete a plugin; confirm its hooks, temp files, and persisted data are cleaned up.

required.aliases: file format support / document format support
required.day1_tell: Upload each supported document format; confirm parsing succeeds or unsupported formats error clearly.

required.aliases: argument handling fix / argument handling / argument key handling
required.day1_tell: Invoke command with quoted, missing, and repeated arguments; confirm parsed keys/values are correct.

required.aliases: authentication error messaging / authentication error handling
required.day1_tell: Use invalid credentials; confirm authentication error is specific and does not leak secrets.

required.aliases: path validation / install path validation / path safety validation
required.day1_tell: Enter absolute, relative, symlink, and traversal paths; confirm unsafe paths are rejected.

required.aliases: native upload handling / file upload handling / upload filename handling
required.day1_tell: Upload a file with spaces/unicode in filename; confirm native upload succeeds and name is preserved/sanitized.

required.aliases: internationalization support / internationalization enhancement
required.day1_tell: Set browser/system locale to supported language; confirm UI loads matching internationalized resources.

required.aliases: missing configuration warning / configuration warning fallback / configuration error messaging
required.day1_tell: Remove required config; confirm startup warns with actionable fallback/error.

required.aliases: sandbox support / sandbox feature work / workspace sandbox features
required.day1_tell: Run a file operation inside sandbox; confirm access is limited to workspace.

required.aliases: download type handling / file download handling / file download routing
required.day1_tell: Download text, image, and binary files; confirm each is routed to the correct handler.

required.aliases: path traversal prevention
required.day1_tell: Request file path '../secret'; confirm access is denied and no file is read.

required.aliases: payload compatibility / payload compatibility fix
required.day1_tell: Send legacy and current payload shapes; confirm compatibility or clear validation errors.

required.aliases: configuration reset / configuration reset command / configuration reset fix
required.day1_tell: Run configuration reset; confirm settings return to defaults and old values are removed.

required.aliases: schema validation compliance / schema validation models / schema validation
required.day1_tell: Validate good and bad configs against schema; confirm only compliant models pass.

required.aliases: streaming persistence optimization / streaming rate reduction / streaming performance optimization
required.day1_tell: Stream a long response; confirm persistence writes are throttled and final content is complete.

required.aliases: mobile layout adjustment / mobile layout adaptation / mobile ui adaptation
required.day1_tell: Open on narrow mobile viewport; confirm controls remain usable without horizontal scrolling.

required.aliases: plugin identifier validation / identifier format validation / identifier validation compatibility
required.day1_tell: Create plugin IDs with invalid chars/case; confirm invalid IDs are rejected consistently.

required.aliases: cross-platform file reading / file input support / file reading support
required.day1_tell: Read files with Windows, macOS, and Linux line endings/paths; confirm content loads correctly.

required.aliases: configuration persistence / plugin configuration persistence
required.day1_tell: Change plugin config, restart app; confirm plugin setting persists.

required.aliases: database migration integration / database migration compatibility / database migration packaging
required.day1_tell: Run migrations from previous DB version; confirm schema upgrades and app starts.

required.aliases: message routing / message routing rule / message role routing
required.day1_tell: Send messages for each role/routing rule; confirm each reaches the intended handler.

required.aliases: performance optimization / system optimization
required.day1_tell: Run baseline workload; confirm latency/memory improves or stays within target budget.

required.aliases: mention parsing fix / mention parsing / mention parsing optimization
required.day1_tell: Send mentions at start, middle, unicode, and email-like text; confirm only valid mentions parse.

required.aliases: credential configuration / credential format validation / credential validation
required.day1_tell: Save malformed and normalized credentials; confirm validation rejects bad format and accepts valid.

required.aliases: streaming response latency / stream response compatibility / streaming response handling
required.day1_tell: Stream provider response with chunks and final marker; confirm first token latency and completion handling.

required.aliases: user access blocking / blocked user handling / user blocking
required.day1_tell: Send request as blocked user; confirm access is denied and no side effects occur.

required.aliases: history clearing fix / history retention configuration / history retention fix
required.day1_tell: Clear history then reload; confirm deleted history does not reappear and retention rules apply.

required.aliases: navigation entries / navigation links
required.day1_tell: Open navigation menu; confirm new entries link to correct pages and permissions.

required.aliases: task interface / task handling integration
required.day1_tell: Create, update, and complete a task via interface; confirm state transitions persist.

required.aliases: parameter compatibility / parameter type support
required.day1_tell: Pass parameters as string, number, boolean, and array; confirm supported types are accepted.

required.aliases: message serialization fix / response serialization fix
required.day1_tell: Serialize message/response containing unicode and attachments; confirm round trip preserves fields.

required.aliases: dynamic model discovery / model discovery support
required.day1_tell: Query model list from provider; confirm available models populate dynamically.

required.aliases: configuration template optimization / configuration loading optimization
required.day1_tell: Load config template with overrides; confirm load time and resulting config are correct.

required.aliases: recording behavior fix / feedback recording fix
required.day1_tell: Submit feedback/recording action; confirm exactly one record with correct metadata is stored.

required.aliases: capability indicator display / capability display indicators
required.day1_tell: Display model/tool capability indicators; confirm badges match actual capabilities.

required.aliases: duplicate display fix
required.day1_tell: Render list with duplicate IDs/names; confirm duplicates are not shown twice unintentionally.

required.aliases: filename sanitization / name sanitization
required.day1_tell: Upload filename with slashes, control chars, and unicode; confirm stored name is safe.

required.aliases: fallback request routing / route fallback fix
required.day1_tell: Request unknown route; confirm fallback route returns expected page/error.

required.aliases: invalid parameter removal / parameter removal
required.day1_tell: Send request containing removed invalid parameter; confirm it is omitted before provider call.

required.aliases: platform compatibility fix / platform compatibility
required.day1_tell: Run smoke test on supported platforms; confirm no platform-specific path/runtime failure.

required.aliases: embedding provider support / embedding provider integration
required.day1_tell: Generate embedding through configured provider; confirm vector dimensions and metadata are correct.

required.aliases: plugin update tracking / plugin update detection
required.day1_tell: Install older plugin then check updates; confirm available update is detected.

required.aliases: state reset fix
required.day1_tell: Trigger state reset action; confirm all intended state clears and unrelated state remains.

required.aliases: background command execution / background handler execution
required.day1_tell: Run background command; confirm UI remains responsive and result is reported.

required.aliases: input composition handling / composition input handling
required.day1_tell: Type with IME composition then press Enter; confirm message sends only after composition ends.

required.aliases: configuration interface improvement / configuration interface
required.day1_tell: Open configuration UI and edit a setting; confirm validation, save, and reload work.

required.aliases: clipboard utility fix / clipboard compatibility fix
required.day1_tell: Copy text using clipboard utility in supported browsers/runtimes; confirm clipboard contains exact text.

required.aliases: upload error handling
required.day1_tell: Force upload network/server error; confirm user sees actionable upload error.

required.aliases: module path alignment / module path fix
required.day1_tell: Import module via documented path; confirm resolved module path matches package layout.

required.aliases: transition layout stability / layout stability
required.day1_tell: Trigger panel/page transition; confirm layout does not jump or collapse.

required.aliases: audio input support / voice input support
required.day1_tell: Record or upload audio input; confirm transcription/upload pipeline receives audio.

required.aliases: environment variable propagation / environment setting propagation
required.day1_tell: Set env var before launch; confirm child processes/API clients receive it.

required.aliases: response content filtering / response filtering
required.day1_tell: Return response containing disallowed content marker; confirm filter removes or blocks it.

required.aliases: dependency addition
required.day1_tell: Install from lockfile; confirm newly added dependency is present and importable.

required.aliases: empty response retry
required.day1_tell: Mock first empty response then valid retry; confirm retry occurs and final answer displays.

required.aliases: url suffix handling / url suffix correction
required.day1_tell: Parse URL with suffix/trailing punctuation; confirm suffix is handled correctly.

required.aliases: tool invocation fix
required.day1_tell: Invoke a tool with valid arguments; confirm execution result is returned to the conversation.

required.aliases: empty-state shortcut / empty state action
required.day1_tell: Open empty state and click shortcut; confirm it performs the advertised action.

required.aliases: frontend asset optimization / frontend optimization
required.day1_tell: Build frontend assets; confirm bundle size/load time meets target and app loads.

required.aliases: ui component simplification / component simplification
required.day1_tell: Render simplified component with previous props; confirm behavior remains equivalent.

required.aliases: password authentication fix / authentication configuration fix
required.day1_tell: Login with valid and invalid password config; confirm authentication behavior is correct.

required.aliases: configuration override support / configuration override fix
required.day1_tell: Apply config override via env/CLI; confirm it takes precedence where documented.

required.aliases: media handling fix / media delivery fix
required.day1_tell: Send media message; confirm delivery, preview, and download all work.

required.aliases: timestamp parsing fix
required.day1_tell: Parse timestamps with timezone, epoch, and ISO formats; confirm displayed time is correct.

required.aliases: configuration precedence
required.day1_tell: Set same option in defaults, file, env, and CLI; confirm precedence order is correct.

required.aliases: configuration type coercion / configuration type handling
required.day1_tell: Provide config values as strings for booleans/numbers; confirm coercion is correct or rejected.

required.aliases: undefined value handling / undefined value fix
required.day1_tell: Pass undefined optional fields; confirm no crash and defaults apply.

required.aliases: emoji support / emoji response handling
required.day1_tell: Send emoji-only and mixed emoji text; confirm round trip preserves emoji.

required.aliases: reply routing / reply routing fix
required.day1_tell: Reply to a threaded message; confirm reply routes to the correct parent/conversation.

required.aliases: query telemetry / service telemetry
required.day1_tell: Perform query with telemetry enabled; confirm anonymized telemetry event is emitted once.

required.aliases: service configuration migration / configuration auto migration
required.day1_tell: Start with old service config; confirm automatic migration produces new config.

required.aliases: instance identifier management / instance identifier retrieval
required.day1_tell: Start two instances; confirm each reports a stable unique instance ID.

required.aliases: file audio support / audio file support
required.day1_tell: Upload audio file formats; confirm supported files are processed and unsupported rejected.

required.aliases: streaming mode toggle / streaming mode fix
required.day1_tell: Toggle streaming mode on/off; confirm responses follow selected mode.

required.aliases: api integration update / api integration
required.day1_tell: Run sample API integration call; confirm request and response match updated API.

required.aliases: message handling refactor / message flow refactor
required.day1_tell: Send normal, tool, and error messages; confirm refactored flow preserves behavior.

required.aliases: log level adjustment
required.day1_tell: Set log level to debug/warn; confirm emitted logs respect level.

required.aliases: image generation compatibility / image compatibility
required.day1_tell: Send image generation request to each supported provider; confirm compatibility handling works.

required.aliases: startup configuration fix / startup entry fix
required.day1_tell: Start app from configured startup entry; confirm correct config loads.

required.aliases: role message merging / message role fix
required.day1_tell: Merge consecutive role messages; confirm roles are preserved and provider accepts payload.

required.aliases: task cancellation scoping / task cancellation
required.day1_tell: Cancel one task among several; confirm only the scoped task stops.

optional.aliases: prompt reset isolation / prompt reset handling / prompt state isolation
optional.day1_tell: Reset prompt in one conversation; confirm other conversations retain their prompt state.
Run translation key audit; confirm no visible key is missing in supported locales.

optional.aliases: log display improvement / log display cleanup / log display optimization
optional.day1_tell: Open logs containing long lines and ANSI/control chars; confirm display remains readable and clean.

optional.aliases: usage metric correction / usage metric extraction / usage metric handling
optional.day1_tell: Compare reported token/usage metrics with provider payload; confirm totals match.

optional.aliases: polling failure recovery / polling retry handling / polling loop recovery
optional.day1_tell: Make polling endpoint fail twice then recover; confirm retries continue and state resumes.

optional.aliases: websocket messaging / websocket client / websocket delivery fix
optional.day1_tell: Send message over websocket; confirm client receives exactly one ordered delivery.

optional.aliases: code block segmentation / semantic code segmentation
optional.day1_tell: Segment code containing nested fences/functions; confirm chunks preserve semantic boundaries.

optional.aliases: image upload support / image upload fix
optional.day1_tell: Upload PNG/JPEG image; confirm it is accepted, previewed, and sent to backend.
Inspect outgoing request body; confirm it matches documented API format.
Send rapid messages below and above batching timeout; confirm batching flushes at expected time.

optional.aliases: test reliability fix / test failure fix
optional.day1_tell: Run the flaky test 50 times; confirm it passes consistently.
Build container from scratch; confirm image builds and starts successfully.
Start dev environment with dev DB config; confirm it connects to the intended database.
Create temp resources then cancel operation; confirm temp files/handles are removed.

optional.aliases: command suggestion support / command suggestion feature
optional.day1_tell: Type command prefix; confirm relevant suggestions appear and can be selected.

optional.aliases: rendering issue fix / ui rendering fixes
optional.day1_tell: Open affected UI screen; confirm text, icons, and controls render without visual defects.
Render characters missing from primary font; confirm fallback font displays them.

optional.aliases: qr registration flow / qr configuration flow
optional.day1_tell: Complete QR registration scan flow; confirm configuration is saved and usable.
Start with invalid config types; confirm validation reports exact fields.

optional.aliases: blank input guard / empty input guard
optional.day1_tell: Submit blank input via keyboard and paste; confirm no request is sent.
Change preference, reload page/app; confirm preference persists.
Send attachment add/remove event; confirm message attachment state updates correctly.

optional.aliases: usage statistics command / usage statistics dashboard
optional.day1_tell: Run usage statistics command/dashboard; confirm displayed totals match stored events.
Resolve cached and uncached paths; confirm canonical path is correct after file moves.
Render code in several languages; confirm syntax highlighting applies and plain text fallback works.
Process list containing empty messages; confirm empties are filtered before send.

optional.aliases: display readability styling / code readability styling
optional.day1_tell: Render dense code/text block; confirm contrast, wrapping, and spacing are readable.

optional.aliases: tool selection handling / tool selection guidance
optional.day1_tell: Request a task requiring tools; confirm tool selection guidance chooses/asks appropriately.
Send overlong message; confirm truncation guard warns or blocks before data loss.

optional.aliases: dependency security patching / security dependency update
optional.day1_tell: Run dependency vulnerability scan; confirm patched dependency removes known advisory.
Pass payload through middleware; confirm original object is not mutated.
Enter credentials with whitespace/case variants; confirm normalized stored value works.

optional.aliases: status badge visibility / status visibility fix
optional.day1_tell: Toggle status badge conditions; confirm badge visibility matches state.
Switch locales and open new feature; confirm added translation keys show localized text.
Click documentation links; confirm they open valid current docs.
Set custom API endpoint; confirm requests go to that endpoint.

optional.aliases: oauth service extraction / oauth service integration
optional.day1_tell: Complete OAuth login flow; confirm extracted service issues usable tokens.
Follow deployment docs on clean environment; confirm service is reachable.

optional.aliases: model initialization handling / model initialization refactor
optional.day1_tell: Initialize model with missing/invalid config; confirm graceful error or fallback.
Use inline mode trigger; confirm inline result inserts at cursor/context.

optional.aliases: streaming output support / streaming tool support
optional.day1_tell: Stream tool output; confirm incremental chunks display and final result completes.

optional.aliases: model option filtering / model filtering support
optional.day1_tell: Apply model filter criteria; confirm only matching models are selectable.
Attempt code to read outside sandbox/network; confirm sandbox blocks it.
Generate image; confirm resulting image displays with correct metadata.
Check command list for current user/context; confirm unavailable commands are hidden/disabled.
Edit a sent message; confirm conversation updates and downstream state is consistent.
Delete one paired user/assistant message; confirm paired deletion behavior is correct.
Set model parameters like temperature/max tokens; confirm provider request includes them.

optional.aliases: history deletion logic / history cleanup logic
optional.day1_tell: Delete history entries by rule; confirm only targeted records are removed.
Use two users concurrently; confirm preferences/history/session state do not leak.
Open, close, and reload panel; confirm panel state restores correctly.
Change language setting and restart; confirm selected language persists.
Exercise tuple-returning function with expected values; confirm unpacking order is correct.
Run translation detection/correction case; confirm corrected locale/string is used.

optional.aliases: localized prompt fix / localized prompt refresh
optional.day1_tell: Change locale then render localized prompt; confirm prompt refreshes in new language.

optional.aliases: null configuration check / null configuration handling
optional.day1_tell: Start with null config object/section; confirm defaults or clear error apply.

optional.aliases: text length handling / long text handling
optional.day1_tell: Submit very long text; confirm length limits, wrapping, and processing are safe.
Send image recognition request; confirm recognized content is returned.
Install minimal module set; confirm optional modules load only when needed.
Send compressed image; confirm it is decompressed/recognized correctly.
Set different prompts in two conversations; confirm isolation is maintained.
Run concurrent updates to shared resource; confirm lock prevents race/inconsistent state.

optional.aliases: model selection fix / model selection update
optional.day1_tell: Select model, reload, and send request; confirm selected model is used.
Add unsupported fields to request payload; confirm they are filtered before send.
Mock provider response variants; confirm model response parser returns correct text/data.

optional.aliases: prompt rendering fix / prompt rendering simplification
optional.day1_tell: Render prompt preview with variables; confirm output is simple and correct.

optional.aliases: event stream abstraction / event stream handling
optional.day1_tell: Consume event stream with data, error, and close events; confirm abstraction emits correct events.
Resolve default path on fresh install; confirm corrected path exists and is writable.
Resolve ambiguous resource names; confirm resolver chooses documented target or errors clearly.
Attempt action before and after granting permission; confirm permission check behavior is correct.

optional.aliases: adapter initialization guard / adapter initialization validation
optional.day1_tell: Initialize adapter with missing config; confirm guard prevents invalid startup.
Run installer script on clean machine/container; confirm install completes and service starts.

optional.aliases: editor bug fix / editor entry fix
optional.day1_tell: Open editor entry and perform edit/save; confirm bug is absent.

optional.aliases: path conversion fix / path conversion logic
optional.day1_tell: Convert paths between URL/native formats; confirm spaces/unicode/separators survive correctly.
Trigger handled error with feedback disabled/enabled; confirm feedback behavior follows setting.
Reload plugin after code/config change; confirm old instance unloads and new one runs.
Navigate history with filters applied; confirm only matching history appears in order.
